🚨 Latest CLARITY Act update — Sept. 16, 2026
The U.S. Senate voted 49–50 against advancing the CLARITY Act in yesterday’s procedural vote. It needed 60 votes, so the bill did not clear the Senate hurdle. 

❌ Not passed

❌ Did not reach the 60 votes needed

🏛️ The bill is stalled in the Senate, not permanently dead.

The main disagreement is over ethics restrictions involving government officials and crypto holdings, along with some stablecoin provisions. 

The failure immediately pressured crypto markets; reports said Bitcoin fell around 3% following the vote. 

Bottom line: As of Sept. 16, 2026, CLARITY Act = stalled, not passed. It could still return if senators reach a new agreement, but the path to passage this year has become much harder.
